scope: Direct deductive verification of the actual three context publication kernel functions after TypeScript erasure. Caller hashes identify reviewed integration; they are not caller correctness proofs.
assumptions: The native private state owns writable token and closed data properties; old and retained tokens remain ordinary live objects.
JavaScript fresh object identity, TypeScript erasure, parser/extractor, Gillian semantics, verifier and solver are trusted.
Browser lifecycle, AbortSignal behavior, caller ownership and native callbacks require separate integration contracts.
